title: Mother's Home
description:
Mother’s Home is a psychological horror game. The player is left alone at home while their mother is taken to the hospital. Sarah soon finds out she is not alone, and her mother is back inside the house. The only safe place is the tent in Sarah's room. 

• Use the light inside your tent to keep the mother at bay.

• Listen for clues to know when the mother might be coming.

• Look for items to burn the home.

• Checkpoints to keep your progress.

• Consistent action

• Escape the house with your life. 

• She's always watching.

Explore the unsettling atmosphere of your home, while your demonic mother tries to possess you. Luckily, you and your father built a tent inside your room that will become your only safe place. Thanks dad. 

Average play time is 1 hour.
